central_question: After documented local loss of Thalassia, does retention by another seagrass preserve the same measured hydrodynamic attenuation as nearby persistent Thalassia within the same long-monitored meadow?

ecological_contrast.definition_A: historically documented Thalassia loss with seagrass occupancy retained; contemporaneously Thalassia absent and another seagrass present
ecological_contrast.definition_B: same stable node; contemporaneously Thalassia present with >=3-year continuous Thalassia record ending at the deployment baseline
ecological_contrast.interpretation: This links documented occupancy continuity after focal loss to a measured ecosystem physical function; it does not assume that retrospective community composition already established a local insurance mechanism.

cohort.pair_selection: Apply exactly the response-independent algorithm in the preflight to the latest eligible fixed-transect state before any velocity outcome is collected.
cohort.transportability_context: Qualifying Lower Tampa Bay or Boca Ciega Bay pairs may be measured and reported descriptively, but cannot be added to the confirmatory sample post hoc to rescue the Old+Middle test.

physical_measurement.sensor_geometry: Use the same frozen inside-canopy and above-canopy/reference velocity geometry as results/direct_hydrodynamic_prospective_v1_contract.json at both states in each pair.
physical_measurement.synchrony: Both state points in a node must be measured simultaneously with their own synchronized local reference volume; a sequential pair is not confirmatory.
physical_measurement.wave_current_resolution: Inherit the parent contract burst-level vector-velocity gate. If oscillatory motion cannot be resolved, claims are restricted to current-speed attenuation.

primary_analysis.inferential_unit: stable transect node / matched state pair
primary_analysis.estimand: mean within-node attenuation difference: loss-legacy alternative state minus persistent-Thalassia state
primary_analysis.direction: two-sided; both weaker and stronger post-turnover attenuation are biologically informative
primary_analysis.uncertainty: 10000-replicate stable-node paired bootstrap; resample complete node pairs; seed 20261008; percentile two-sided 95% interval

classification.pilot_only: fewer than 16 complete pairs or fewer than 6 complete pairs in either Old or Middle Tampa Bay

primary_analysis.equivalence_rule: No equivalence / functional-redundancy claim is authorized from an interval overlapping zero. An equivalence margin would require a separately justified response-independent physical threshold frozen before any velocity outcome and is not part of v1.

secondary_structure_decomposition.question: If the unadjusted physical function differs, is that difference largely represented by present canopy structure or does a residual state/composition contrast remain?
secondary_structure_decomposition.role: mechanism decomposition only; cannot replace or rescue the primary matched physical contrast
secondary_structure_decomposition.boundary: Cover and canopy height can be consequences of species turnover; therefore they are not controlled in the primary total-function contrast.

ecosystem_engineering_attribution.rule: Use 'canopy ecosystem-engineering difference' only if the parent nested bare-bed physical-attribution gate passes under its frozen rules. Otherwise report a difference in measured within-meadow vertical velocity attenuation.
ecosystem_engineering_attribution.no_rescue: A bare-control result cannot rescue an unsupported matched state contrast, and a matched state contrast cannot rescue a failed bare-control attribution gate.

relation_to_other_tampa_mechanisms.tnc: Independent mechanism line. Functional-insurance results cannot rescue the decisive within-node TNC state-augmentation primary.
relation_to_other_tampa_mechanisms.hydrodynamic_self_facilitation: The parent future-Thalassia persistence model remains a separate prospective question.
relation_to_other_tampa_mechanisms.cross_sectional_composition_model: The older thalassia_fraction model remains supportive cross-sectional context and cannot supersede this history-linked matched test.

novelty_boundary: Functional redundancy/insurance among foundation species is established ecology.

The distinctive Tampa test is the longitudinal link: documented focal foundation-species loss -> retained habitat occupancy -> directly measured physical function at the same long-monitored meadow, with a nearby persistent-focal comparator.
This remains observational with respect to species turnover; node matching reduces stable site confounding but does not prove that loss caused a functional difference.
no_post_outcome_changes: Do not change the historical loss definition after velocity outcomes.
Do not switch the comparator from >=3-year persistent Thalassia to a shorter run after velocity outcomes.
Do not increase the 100 m pair-separation limit after velocity outcomes.
Do not select a different loss-legacy or comparator point based on velocity.
Do not promote Lower/Boca observations into the confirmatory population after seeing their attenuation.
Do not call an overlapping confidence interval functional equivalence.
